newsitem.title: FRANCE: BoF's Trichet-bourse rises can help Euro economies.
newsitem.headline: BoF's Trichet-bourse rises can help Euro economies.

text.p: Bank of France head Jean-Claude Trichet said on Thursday stock market rises in Europe could be welcomed as helpful for a more lasting economic upturn.

"We must remain cautious. Market prices are set by buyers and sellers. At the moment we are in a good position and I think we should be pleased for the European economy especially because it is one of the elements which can help make the economic upturn in continental Europe more lasting and solid," Trichet told French RTL radio.
The French stock market hit a new all-time high on Wednesday and other bourses also rose.
